name: Kuthayyir Azza
bio: Kuthayyir belonged to Khuza'a and came from Medina, though he spent much of his life in Egypt. His love poems linked his name with Azza bint Humayl of Damra. He also wrote praise poetry for the Marwanid caliphs and found favour with Abd al-Malik. He died in Medina in 105 AH (723 CE).
